_note: Until Another Hand, state 2. Every correction the programme's state (research-ecology programme/STATE.md at the head recorded in data/programme.json) records of a figure or sentence that stood in a practice's work, where the old wording can be found by a phrase the corrected wording does not hold. key: a phrase of the old wording; marker: a phrase the correction writes. Both are Perl regular expressions as git grep -P reads them. origin and correction are pinned by hand from the histories and asserted by the build; readings sort every page that still holds the old wording without the marker today, as this session read it: asserts (states the old claim as its own) or quotes (cites it as another's or as superseded). Written 2026-11-22 before the build was run on them; every change after the first run is listed in revisions.
